stepTitle: Which description matches the sampling distribution you would plot?
stepBody: This problem is unrelated to the previous problem. Suppose you have a box containing prize tickets. Half of the tickets are worth $$0$$ dollars, and other half are worth $$3$$ dollars. Suppose you draw a simple random sample of size $$3$$ with replacement from the box.\nPlot the sampling distribution of the sample mean and provide titles for the axes.
answerLatex: The sample mean takes the values $$0$$, $$1$$, $$2$$ and $$3$$ with probabilities $$1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8$$
choices: The sample mean takes the values $$0$$, $$1$$, $$2$$ and $$3$$ each with probability $$\frac{1}{4}$$
The sample mean takes the values $$0$$, $$1$$, $$2$$ and $$3$$ with probabilities $$1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8$$
The sample mean takes the values $$0$$ and $$3$$ each with probability $$\frac{1}{2}$$
The sample mean takes the values $$0$$, $$1.5$$ and $$3$$ with probabilities $$1/4,1/2,1/4$$
The sample mean takes the values $$0$$, $$3$$, $$6$$ and $$9$$ with probabilities $$1/8,3/8,3/8,1/8$$
